title: Understanding Age as a Feature
text: Consider how age might influence Netflix watch-time. Think about whether age should be treated as a continuous variable or if it might be more meaningful to categorize it into groups.

title: Using Age Values Raw
text: Is it reasonable to use age values directly in the model without any transformation?

title: Transforming Age Data
text: Think about whether transforming age data into categories (like age groups) might capture different patterns in watch-time behavior. What are the pros and cons of such an approach?

title: Categorizing Age Data
text: Would it be beneficial to categorize age into groups (e.g., $$18-24$$, $$25-34$$, etc.) for the model?
